name: Gestao Hospital
description: We need an API to organize a public health system, specifically to assist the Unified Health System (SUS) in Brazil. The goal is to create a tool that helps avoid waste and optimize resources based on patient needs. The system should manage hospital information, including their stock of products, blood banks, and available beds. It should be able to recommend the closest hospital with available beds to a patient and facilitate the transfer of products, such as blood, between nearby hospitals if one is in need. A hospital with four or fewer items or liters of a product is considered to have only enough for its own use. The API should allow for registering hospitals, indicating the closest hospital to a patient's location, managing patient check-in and check-out, checking available beds, and managing product and blood bank inventories within hospitals.
highLevelGoals: The Public Health System Administrator aims to efficiently manage and distribute resources, including hospital beds, medical products, and blood, to minimize waste and meet patient needs effectively.

The Public Health System Administrator seeks to ensure that patients are directed to the most suitable and closest hospitals with available resources, thereby improving patient care and operational efficiency.

The Public Health System Administrator aims to enable seamless and rapid transfer of critical resources like blood and medical products between hospitals to address shortages and support patient care.
The Patient aims to receive precise and timely recommendations for the closest hospital with available beds, ensuring quick access to necessary medical care.
The Patient desires an efficient and hassle-free process for hospital check-in and check-out, reducing wait times and administrative burden.
The Hospital Staff aims to streamline the process of patient check-in and check-out, ensuring accurate record-keeping and smooth transitions for patients.
The Hospital Staff seeks to have up-to-date information on available beds to effectively manage patient flow and allocate resources.
The Hospital Staff aims to maintain precise control over product and blood bank inventories, preventing shortages and ensuring critical supplies are always available.
